title: Multi2AV-Safety: Benchmarking Safety in Multimodal-to-Audio-Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.26535v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Audio-video generation is rapidly moving from prompt-driven synthesis toward multimodal conditioning, where text, images, audio, and video can jointly shape the generated output. This shift changes the nature of safety evaluation: harmful intent may no longer reside in any single input, but instead emerge from how otherwise benign or weakly harmful conditions interact across modalities and time. Existing safety benchmarks, however, remain largely prompt-centric or tied to fixed conditioning interfaces, leaving such compositional risks difficult to study systematically. To bridge this gap, we introduce Multi2AV-Safety, the first safety benchmark, to the best of our knowledge, to cover all 11 non-singleton T/I/A/V conditioning configurations for audio-video generation, comprising 11,024 attack instances. translated_title: Multi2AV-Safety：多模态到音视频生成中的安全性基准测试
translated_abstract: 音频-视频生成正迅速从基于提示的合成转向多模态条件化，其中文本、图像、音频和视频可以共同塑造生成输出。这一转变改变了安全评估的性质：有害意图可能不再存在于任何单一输入中，而是源于原本良性或弱有害条件在跨模态和时间上的交互方式。然而，现有的安全基准大多以提示为中心或绑定于固定的条件接口，使得这类组合风险难以系统研究。为弥补这一空白，我们引入了Multi2AV-Safety，据我们所知，这是首个覆盖音视频生成中所有11种非单例T/I/A/V条件配置的安全基准，包含11,024个攻击实例。在Multi2AV-Safety上的评估揭示了代表性多模态安全防护在攻击机制和危害类型上的系统性弱点。
tldr: 本文提出了首个覆盖所有多模态条件配置的音视频生成安全基准Multi2AV-Safety，包含11,024个攻击实例，并揭示了现有安全防护在组合性风险中的系统性弱点。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Multi2AV-Safety, the first safety benchmark covering all multimodal conditioning configurations for audio-video generation with 11,024 attack instances, revealing systematic weaknesses in existing safety guards against compositional risks.
